      AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) IN (7, 8, 9)
"""), engine)
print("Rush-hour readings (07,08,09) for 14,16,17:", rush_count['cnt'][0])

# Overnight hours (00,01,02,03,04) for stations 14,16,17 in June 2025

"""), engine)

rush_means = pd.read_sql(text("""

           AVG(no2) AS rush_mean_no2,
           COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM hourly_station_air_quality
    WHERE station_id IN (14, 16, 17)

    ORDER BY station_id
"""), engine)

# Overnight means (hours 00,01,02,03,04) per station
overnight_means = pd.read_sql(text("""
